law.title: Requirements for turning on highway (2)
law.text: A signal of intention to turn right or left, or otherwise turn a vehicle from a direct course, shall be given continuously during not less than the last 100 feet traveled in a business or residential district and not less than the last 300 feet traveled in any other area prior to changing the course of a vehicle. This rule shall be observed, regardless of the weather.

activation_conditions: the subject is about to turn right or left, or otherwise change course
exceptions: none — the rule states expressly that it is observed regardless of the weather
residue: 'business or residential district' is a legal region class: a reading assumption that selects which of the two distances applies
